name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through a racing family, but through a fascination with engineering. He spent his childhood taking apart and rebuilding anything he could get his hands on, fueled by a curiosity to understand how things worked. This led him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, where he specialized in materials science and quality assurance. 

After graduating, Alistair sought a role where he could combine his passion for engineering with his love for motorsport. He joined Garage 59 as a junior quality control engineer, quickly proving his worth through his meticulous attention to detail and problem-solving abilities. His approach is rooted in data analysis and a deep understanding of the materials used in racing, ensuring that every component meets the highest standards. What sets Alistair apart is his proactive approach to identifying potential issues before they escalate, making him a valuable asset to the team. 

Driven by a desire to continuously improve, Alistair actively seeks out new technologies and methodologies to enhance the team's quality control processes. He believes that rigorous testing and analysis are crucial for achieving optimal performance and reliability on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when concentrating.
Insists on double-checking every measurement, even if someone else has already done it.
